display_name: Claude Code (Anthropic CLI / VS Code extension / Agent SDK)

value: You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK

notes: 2.1.306 (VS Code) and 2.1.309 (CLI): the user-agent is claude-cli/<version> (<entrypoint>) on every turn; the anthropic-beta list and the tool list vary by version and entry point (the CLI registers deferred tools behind ToolSearch), the three identity blocks (billing header, 'You are a Claude agent…', the long instructions) and x-app: cli do not. After a tool call Claude Code appends role: system reminder messages to the messages array; they are extracted as identity texts too. Known imitation: the Codex-based Open Interpreter CLI has a 'claude-code' harness that sends user-agent 'claude-cli/2.1.158 (external, sdk-cli)', x-app and anthropic-beta on purpose; at the request layer it is indistinguishable from this product except by the pinned version string (not captured: its installer needs GitHub releases).
